# Dinesh K N — portfolio-web (JARVIS HUD)

> Next.js 16 portfolio with Iron Man–style command-center UI, voice commands, and Lighthouse perf tooling.

## Key source files

- [app/layout.js](app/layout.js): Root layout + JarvisShell
- [components/jarvis/JarvisShell.js](components/jarvis/JarvisShell.js): HUD chrome
- [lib/site-content.js](lib/site-content.js): Site copy and data
- [lib/jarvis/constants.js](lib/jarvis/constants.js): Routes, storage keys
- [lib/jarvis/intents.js](lib/jarvis/intents.js): Voice intent matching
- [scripts/perf-report.mjs](scripts/perf-report.mjs): Lighthouse reporter
